project: BIO-MIMIC X — UM-HET3 site heterogeneity reanalysis
status: PARTIAL — observational exploratory statistical findings; no causal mediation established

site_coding.1.0: Jackson Laboratory (JL); corroborated 1953 JL prefix IDs
site_coding.2.0: University of Michigan (UM); corroborated 2634 UM prefix IDs
site_coding.3.0: UT Health San Antonio (UT); corroborated 1851 UT prefix IDs

treatment_coding.1.0: pooled compounds not individually significant for lifespan; no specific compound identification

common_cohorts.method: Direct standardization of sex-specific mean lifespan in each site × cohort × treatment cell to the pooled cohort-by-treatment distribution across the 5242 animals; 3000 within-cell bootstrap resamples in JavaScript (Mulberry32)

age_pattern_control_males_common_cohorts.note: Observed fraction with documented lifespan <365; event/censoring status unavailable; not a Kaplan-Meier survival estimate

male_six_month_body_mass.eligibility: Male, with bw6, survived to >=183 days, 12 g < bw6 < 85 g
male_six_month_body_mass.model: sex-specific OLS: lifespan_days ~ site(UM,UT vs JL)+cohort(2006,2009 vs 2005)+treatment_code(1 vs 0); then add bw6_grams

within_site_cohort_treatment_weight_shuf.scope: Tests individual weight-lifespan association beyond site/year/treatment distributions; not causality

negative_evidence: Site-by-sex heterogeneity was already described in Cheng et al., Aging Cell 2019 (DOI 10.1111/acel.12905)
Body mass / longevity relations and sex-differential correlations were already published, including Arends et al. Nature 2026 (DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10407-9)
A full cohort 24,296-mouse survival replication was not executed
Body mass at 6 months and survival are not contemporaneous randomized variables; survival-to-weight-measurement creates selection bias

Original study's Methods text says n=3401 females and n=3037 males, but authors' Figure1.R labels sex code 1 as male and corresponding CSV has 3401 code-1 mice; provenance discrepancy warrants author clarification, not unilateral correction
Censoring indicators, cage/litter, drug-specific dose, and comorbidity provenance not contained in derived 6,438-row snapshot
The new exploratory analysis does not establish a new biological mechanism, intervention effect or longevity treatment
